shared_sample_selection: Fixed stratified sample from ground truth; independent of model predictions
evasion_denominator: Originally correctly detected Attack samples within the shared test sample, separately per model
induction_denominator: Originally correctly classified Benign samples within the shared test sample, separately per model
metric_scale: Rates and metrics stored as fractions from 0 to 1; multiply by 100 to display percentages
limitations: Feature perturbations are not actual PCAP changes.
Modified features may not form physically consistent traffic.
Conditional flip-rate denominators differ across models.
Mean results across scenarios are descriptive, not weighted.
The sampled baseline is not the full test-set baseline.
